name: Superior Channel Spirit
body:
You are a perfect vessel for your chosen spirit.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 17, Channel Spirit, Greater Channel Spirit, Improved Channel Spirit, Spirit Ridden, character level 17th.

Benefit(s): You gain the supreme power granted by the spirit you selected with the Channel Spirit feat. For purposes of using that power, treat your character level as your medium level for all your spirit powers granted by this feat, Channel Spirit, Greater Channel Spirit, and Improved Channel Spirit.
